title: Integral basis reduction for the Kummer root sheaf
statement: Let $C$ be a scheme, $m\in\mathbf N$, $R=\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf Z/m\mathbf Z)$, $A$ an $R$-module, and $L$ an integral module with basis $b_j$ indexed by $j\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)$. Given an integral linear equivalence $e:L/mL\simeq A$, the root sheaf $F=\mu_m$ and coefficient twist from [def-pur-kummer-module-coefficients] admit an isomorphism $\theta:\bigoplus_j F\simeq F\otimes_R A_C$ satisfying $\iota_j\theta=i_{e([b_j])}$. The statement includes $r=0$, $m=0$, and $m=1$.

source.place: Finite-direct-sum argument; integral-lift interpretation in the parent node. Stacks Tags 015B, 03EK and 03PL.

proof.text: Reduce the integral coordinates b_j^* modulo m; each vanishes on the range of multiplication by m and therefore descends through L/mL. Transport through e to obtain additive coordinate maps c_j:A -> R. They are R-linear since every R-scalar is an integer cast. The vectors v_j=e([b_j]) and coordinates obey the Kronecker identities and sum_j c_j(a)v_j=a by lifting a to L and using the integral basis expansion.

Apply the normalized dual-basis sheaf comparison to these vectors and coordinates. This gives precisely the requested isomorphism and the formula on each inclusion. The calculation includes m=0, m=1 and rank zero.

theorem kummer_integral_root_comparison (C : Scheme.{u}) (m : ℕ)
    (A : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m)))
    (L : ModuleCat.{u + 1} ℤ) (r : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) ℤ L)
    (e : (L ⧸ LinearMap.range ((m : ℤ) • (LinearMap.id : L →ₗ[ℤ] L))) ≃ₗ[ℤ] A)
    [HasBiproduct (fun _ : Fin r ↦ C.rootsOfUnitySheaf m)] :
    ∃ theta : (⨁ fun _ : Fin r ↦ C.rootsOfUnitySheaf m) ≅
        (kummerAbelianTwist C m).obj A,
      ∀ j : Fin r, biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin r ↦ C.rootsOfUnitySheaf m) j ≫ theta.hom =
        kummerCoefficientInsertion C m A (e (Submodule.Quotient.mk (b j)))
